resources.string: Espresso poured on a vanilla ice cream. Served in a cappuccino cup.

Espresso with added hot water (100-150 ml). Often served in a cappuccino cup. (The espresso is added into the hot water rather than all the water being flowed through the coffee that would lead to over extraction.)
A tall, mild \'milk coffee\' (about 150-300 ml). An espresso with steamed milk and only a little milk foam poured over it. Serve in a latte glass or a coffee cup. Flavored syrup can be added.

Espresso combined with hot chocolate (or cocoa powder + sugar + milk) and topped with steamed milk. Often finished with whipped cream or a sprinkle of cocoa, giving a mix of coffee bitterness and chocolate sweetness.
Espresso with steamed milk and a thin layer of microfoam. Served in a smaller cup than a latte. The balance highlights the espresso flavor while giving a velvety texture from the milk.
A shot of espresso topped with equal parts of steamed milk and milk foam. Served in a small cup, giving a strong coffee flavor balanced with creamy texture.
